XuanGene

Give your agents
a workflow to follow.

Manage assignments, progress and agent workflows in one project. Visually define roles and input/output events, connect stages such as development and audit, and reuse designs through subflows.

Adapted from Multica with added support for designing agent workflows.

  • Tasks and workflows together

    Assign tasks, follow progress and design multi-agent workflows within the same project.

  • Make routing visible

    Connect development and review roles visually, defining events and routes for approval or revision.

  • Reuse workflows as subflows

    Add existing workflows as subflows to reuse recurring collaboration steps in a clear overall structure.

Explore XuanGene

Example: Design a development workflow

Connect development, review and completion nodes, define their events and add a route back to development when revisions are needed.

  1. Define roles
  2. Connect events and branches
  3. Reuse subflows

    Move from understanding your sources to generating a draft you can review and revise.

ClawMessenger

One topic.
More perspectives.

Bring multiple agents into a discussion, one round at a time. Guide the conversation at checkpoints and capture perspectives, agreements and differences in discussion notes.

  • One topic, several perspectives

    Let agents with different roles discuss one topic in rounds, adding perspectives and responding to each other.

  • Guide the conversation

    Review progress at checkpoints, add direction or questions and decide how the discussion should proceed.

  • Capture what matters

    Summarize perspectives, agreements and disagreements so you can review the reasoning and plan next steps.

Explore ClawMessenger

Example: Discuss the next product priority

Invite product, engineering and operations perspectives, add constraints at a checkpoint and summarize agreements and open questions.

  1. Set the topic and roles
  2. Discuss and review
  3. Summarize the outcome
